description: CTA - Ridership - Avg. Weekday Bus Stop Boardings in October 2012 is a dataset listed in City of Chicago open data portal (data.cityofchicago.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Chicago. This dataset shows approximate, average, weekday boardings by bus stop from the month of October 2012. Coverage: Chicago. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are sustainability, public transit, chicago transit authority, cta, ridership. The table has 18 columns. Attribution on the portal: Chicago Transit Authority. The portal shows 2012-12-20 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofchicago-org-portal.
